name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a National Mission for Financial Inclusion launched across India in August 2014. The scheme aims to provide universal banking services and financial inclusion, including basic savings bank accounts, access to need-based credit, remittances, insurance and pension services. Beyond 14.08.2018, the focus shifted from opening accounts for every household to every unbanked adult.
benefits: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) with no minimum balance requirement.
Account holders can use bank branches, ATMs and Banking Correspondents for depositing and withdrawing cash.
Under the supplied source, cash withdrawal from the BSBDA is limited to four times a month.
Small Account or Chota Khata can be opened without presenting legal documents, subject to the source's stated conditions.

Small Accounts are normally valid for twelve months and can continue for another twelve months if the account holder provides a document showing that they applied for an Officially Valid Document within the first twelve months.
Free RuPay debit card with built-in accidental insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for beneficiaries.
Accounts opened before 28.08.2018 have the ₹1 lakh accidental insurance cover stated by the source.
Banking Correspondents or Bank Mitras provide banking services including savings, deposits, payments, withdrawals and mini account statements, particularly in remote or rural areas.
PMJDY facilitates access to financial services including savings, credit, remittances, insurance and pension.

rules.description: Applicant should be an Indian National.

documents.description: Government-issued identity proof. Acceptable documents include Voter Card, PAN Card, or Ration Card.
Proof of permanent address. Acceptable documents include Passport, Driving License, Electricity Bill, Telephone Bill, or Water Bill.
Recent passport-size photograph of the applicant.

documents.document_name: Filled and Signed PMJDY Account Opening Form
documents.description: Completed and signed PMJDY Account Opening Form downloaded from the official portal.

documents.document_name: Any other document as notified by the Central Government
documents.description: Any other document as notified by the Central Government in consultation with the Regulator.

tutorial_steps.title: Visit the official PMJDY portal
tutorial_steps.description: Visit the official PMJDY portal at https://pmjdy.gov.in/.

tutorial_steps.title: Find the Account Opening Form
tutorial_steps.description: Under the e-documents section, find the live links for Account Opening Form.

tutorial_steps.title: Select the appropriate form
tutorial_steps.description: Select the appropriate English or Hindi form.

tutorial_steps.title: Download and print the form
tutorial_steps.description: Download the PDF and print it.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill the form manually
tutorial_steps.description: Fill the form manually with bank and personal information including bank branch, town or village, block or district, Aadhaar number, profession, annual income, Kisan Credit Card details and other requested information.

tutorial_steps.title: Provide documents and contact information
tutorial_steps.description: Provide the required documents along with mobile number or email ID.
